shell.window.title.note: Native Windows window title and the app's own brand name; do not translate the name.

shell.nav.label.note: Accessible name of the persistent navigation region.

shell.nav.stats.note: Navigation link after Overview to daily points and completion history.

shell.route.stats.title.note: Stats route title for the mock shell and screen-load error fallback.

shell.nav.live.note: Navigation link to the current or most recent run.

shell.nav.settings.note: Navigation link to app and run settings.

shell.route.setup.title.note: Title for the mock setup page and a setup screen-load error.

shell.route.overview.title.note: Title for the mock Overview and its screen-load error.

shell.route.live.title.note: Title for the mock Live run and its screen-load error.

shell.route.history.title.note: Title for the mock History and its screen-load error.

shell.route.accounts.title.note: Title for the mock Accounts and its screen-load error.

shell.route.settings.title.note: Title for the mock Settings and its screen-load error.

shell.nav.live_active.note: Visually hidden status added to the Live run navigation link while a run is active; the accent dot is only reinforcement.

shell.update.available.note: Update banner above the screen; version is an unmodified release version string.

shell.update.download.note: Open the verified release URL in the browser; short update-banner button.

shell.account.none.note: Account footer before the first account has been added.

shell.error.title.note: Heading after a screen module fails to load.

shell.error.body.text: Try again. If this keeps happening, restart the app.
shell.error.body.note: Friendly recovery guidance for a screen-load error, no technical traceback.

shell.mock.label.note: Visible label on all mock shell screenshots. These are not real account measurements.

shell.mock.today.note: Mock date subtitle copied from the approved comp.

shell.mock.tasks.note: Mock day-plan heading copied from the approved comp.

shell.mock.open_label.note: Mock measured-work label copied from the approved comp.

shell.mock.open_value.note: Synthetic comp-only open-work value, never a production default.

shell.mock.balance.note: Mock balance label copied from the approved comp.

shell.mock.points.note: Unit below the mock large balance number.

shell.mock.earned.note: Mock earned-points label copied from the approved comp.

shell.mock.next_label.note: Mock scheduled-run label copied from the approved comp.

shell.mock.next_time.note: Synthetic schedule time copied from the approved comp, never a live promise.

shell.mock.automatic.note: Mock schedule mode copied from the approved comp.

shell.mock.independent.text: Runs even when the app is closed
shell.mock.independent.note: Mock explanation of an installed Windows Task Scheduler schedule.

shell.mock.run_now.note: Demo primary action copied from the approved comp; mock transport only.

shell.mock.goal.text: 2,300 points to a 5 € gift card, about 12 days
shell.mock.goal.note: Approved comp illustration only. Price and estimate are synthetic and do not appear in the live screen.

shell.mock.chart.note: Mock chart heading copied from the approved comp.

shell.mock.one_open.note: Synthetic card count in the mock task plan.

shell.mock.no_streak.note: Approved comp's synthetic skip explanation only; this is not a backend reason code.

shell.mock.searches.note: Synthetic search-points progress in the mock task plan.

shell.mock.quests.note: Synthetic quest progress in the mock task plan.

shell.mock.placeholder.text: The shared frame is ready. This screen has its own build lane.
shell.mock.placeholder.note: Only in mock/shell placeholders, never in a production screen module.

shell.demo.title.note: Heading of the mock-only component gallery.

shell.demo.component.note: Mock component sample heading; name is the exact technical component id, not translated.

shell.demo.label.note: Mock-only generic label used to demonstrate component layout.

shell.demo.description.note: Mock-only supporting description to exercise long translations.

shell.demo.option_a.note: First option in mock component demos.

shell.demo.option_b.note: Second option in mock component demos.

shell.demo.option_c.note: Third option in mock component demos.

shell.demo.progress.note: Progress-ring accessible label in the mock component gallery.

shell.demo.dialog.body.note: Mock-only dialog description; no external action is taken.
